title: crocus heuffelianus subsp. albiflorus
intro: Crocus heuffelianus subsp. albiflorus, commonly known as the white crocus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the iris family, characterized by its white or pale yellow flowers. The health benefits of Crocus heuffelianus subsp. albiflorus include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The plant has been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative and anti-anxiety effects, possibly due to its bioactive constituents, which include glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Crocus heuffelianus subsp. albiflorus may also contribute to its potential uses in traditional medicine, including the treatment of cardiovascular and respiratory disorders.
